text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1063, Starfish Front Door Knocker in Nickel Silver

The Large Nickel Silver Starfish Door Knocker is a great addition to any oceanside home. It is finished in a Michael Healy original finish. Nickel Silver finish is achieved by giving the piece a nickel plating to make its warm silver color. The Nickel Silver Premium Starfish Door Knocker is large enough for even big doors. It has a 2-1/8 inch mounting centers and comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Also Available: smaller 4-3/4" Nickel Silver Starfish Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Nickel Silver Starfish Premium Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Nickel Silver
  • Height: 6-1/2"
  • Width: 6-3/4"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 2-1/8"
  • Projection Off Door: 2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Available in 2 finishes:
Nickel Silver Polished Brass and Bronze

Sold Individually
